abstract: This study utilizes nationally representative panel data on rural Chinese households to investigate the interrelationship between smallholders’ participation in land rental markets and their agricultural commercialization while also evaluating the interactive effects of these market‐oriented farming practices on agricultural land and labor productivity. We adopted a bivariate Tobit model, fixed effects models, and instrumental variable methods to address the endogeneity problems. Results reveal a mutually reinforcing relationship between farm households’ land rental area and commercialization decisions. Furthermore, renting farmland is associated with improved agricultural labor productivity and reduced land productivity. Agricultural commercialization shows a positive correlation with the productivity of both land and labor for farm households. Finally, commercialization could positively moderate the association between land renting and agricultural productivity. Policymakers should design policies and strategies to promote the development of the land rental market and the commercialization of farmers, which could improve labor and land productivity.
abstract_zh: 本研究利用具有全国代表性的中国农村家庭面板数据，探讨小农户参与土地租赁市场与其农业商业化之间的相互关系，同时评估这些市场化农业实践对农业土地和劳动生产率的交互效应。我们采用双变量Tobit模型、固定效应模型和工具变量方法来解决内生性问题。结果显示，农户土地租赁面积与商业化决策之间存在相互促进的关系。此外，租赁耕地与农业劳动生产率提高和土地生产率下降相关。农业商业化与农户土地和劳动生产率均呈正相关。最后，商业化能够正向调节土地租赁与农业生产率之间的关系。政策制定者应设计促进土地租赁市场发展和农民商业化的政策与策略，从而提升劳动和土地生产率。

abstract: Governments often intervene to prevent firm closures during crises, fearing that financially constrained but viable firms may fail. We develop a firm dynamics model with incomplete financial markets and show how financial frictions generate excessive firm exit. A key statistic governing this dynamic inefficiency is the marginal propensity to exit with debt. Using confidential U.S. Census data, we estimate the relationship between debt and exit and use it to discipline the model. The calibrated model implies that eliminating financial frictions reduces firm exit from 9.3\% to 5.0\% and generates welfare gains of 3.6\% in consumption-equivalent terms. We show that the welfare costs of financial frictions rise sharply during financial crises but change little during standard productivity recessions. Finally, we compare government-guaranteed loans and grants, quantifying the trade-off between fiscal cost and effectiveness in preventing excessive exit.
abstract_zh: 政府常会在危机期间干预以防止企业倒闭，担心那些面临财务约束但具有生存能力的企业可能失败。我们构建了一个包含不完全金融市场的企业动态模型，并展示了金融摩擦如何导致企业过度退出。衡量这种动态低效率的关键统计指标是债务驱动的边际退出倾向。利用保密的美国人口普查数据，我们估算了债务与退出之间的关系，并以此校准模型。校准后的模型表明，消除金融摩擦可使企业退出率从9.3%降至5.0%，并以消费等价形式带来3.6%的福利收益。我们进一步发现，金融摩擦的福利成本在金融危机期间急剧上升，但在标准的生产率衰退期间变化甚微。最后，我们比较了政府担保贷款与直接拨款，量化了财政成本与防止过度退出有效性之间的权衡关系。
title: Firm Exit and Financial Frictions
title_zh: 企业退出与金融摩擦

abstract: A representative chooses policy on behalf of a group with heterogeneous preferences. Group members differ in voice (their salience to the representative). The representative maximizes perceived welfare based on a voice-weighted signal. The resulting policy distortion is proportional to the covariance between voice and preferences. When agents choose voice effort endogenously, equilibrium voice is U-shaped (quadratic in distance between preferences and policy). The equilibrium distortion is approximately one-third of a standard deviation times the skewness coefficient. It is non-zero only when the preference distribution is skewed. Combining the voice-weighted signal with a random sample can reduce the expected welfare loss. Previous article in issue Next article in issue
abstract_zh: 一位代表代表一个偏好异质性的群体制定政策。群体成员在话语权（即其对代表的重要性）上存在差异。代表基于话语权加权的信号最大化感知福利。由此产生的政策扭曲与话语权和偏好之间的协方差成正比。当代理人内生地选择话语努力时，均衡话语呈U形（即偏好与政策距离的二次函数）。均衡扭曲约为标准差的三分之一乘以偏度系数。只有当偏好分布呈偏态时，该扭曲才非零。将话语权加权信号与随机样本相结合，可以减少预期福利损失。

abstract: This paper presents a model of how organizations develop complex products. Decentralizing the process into autonomous units increases the potential value of production but raises the risk of miscoordination. The organization coordinates the process through costly and imperfectly reliable coordination channels. It optimally creates redundancy in these channels, thereby determining the robustness of the process to miscoordination. The incentive to invest in robustness strengthens as long as returns to decentralization are increasing. Hence, organizations either centralize processes or decentralize them substantially to exploit increasing returns to decentralization. Small reductions in coordination costs can trigger substantial decentralization and, paradoxically, undermine process reliability. Larger reductions in coordination costs also enhance reliability.
abstract_zh: 本文构建了一个关于组织如何开发复杂产品的模型。将流程分散至自主单元，虽能提升生产的潜在价值，却增加了协调失误的风险。组织通过成本高昂且可靠性有限的协调渠道来统筹流程，并最优地在这些渠道中构建冗余，从而决定流程对协调失误的稳健性。只要分散化的回报递增，投资于稳健性的激励便会增强。因此，组织要么集中流程，要么大幅分散以充分利用分散化的递增回报。协调成本的小幅降低可能引发大幅分散化，并矛盾地削弱流程可靠性；而协调成本的大幅降低则同时增强可靠性。

abstract: Oil is the lifeblood of industry, serving as the core source of power for the operation of industrial machinery. Ensuring its stable supply is crucial for the smooth production process, which in turn is a key determinant in enhancing the quality of export products for enterprises. This study empirically examines the impact of energy supply on the quality of export products and the mechanism of its effect by using a staggered difference‐in‐differences (DID) method with the implementation of China's West‐to‐East Oil Transportation Project as a quasi‐natural experiment. The empirical results show that a dependable energy supply substantially boosts the quality of goods produced for export by various companies. The mechanism analysis shows that energy supply improves export product quality through enterprise performance improvement effects, industry agglomeration effects and supply chain stabilization effects, and it mainly improves export product quality in energy‐importing regions, technology‐intensive industries, private enterprises, and general trade enterprises. Further analysis reveals that a stable supply of energy helps enhance the sustainability of enterprise exports while helping enterprises realize value chain upgrading, helping China get rid of the curse of locking the bottom of the export value chain. The findings of this study help clarify the intrinsic mechanism between energy supply and export product quality and provide an empirical basis for the cross‐regional energy dispatch strategy to help China's export value chain upgrade.
abstract_zh: 摘要 石油是工业的血液，是工业机械运转的核心动力来源。确保其稳定供应对于生产过程的顺利进行至关重要，而这又是提升企业出口产品质量的关键决定因素。本研究以中国“西油东送”工程实施为准自然实验，采用交错双重差分法实证检验了能源供应对出口产品质量的影响及其作用机制。实证结果表明，可靠的能源供应显著提升了各类企业的出口产品质量。机制分析显示，能源供应通过企业绩效提升效应、产业集聚效应和供应链稳定效应改善了出口产品质量，并且主要提升了能源输入地区、技术密集型行业、民营企业和一般贸易企业的出口产品质量。进一步分析发现，稳定的能源供应有助于增强企业出口的可持续性，同时帮助企业实现价值链升级，助力中国摆脱出口价值链低端锁定的困境。本研究结论有助于厘清能源供应与出口产品质量之间的内在机理，并为跨区域能源调度策略助力中国出口价值链升级提供经验依据。

abstract: Biosecurity trade restrictions are commonly framed as preventive measures, yet in many settings they function primarily as policies of delay: they impose immediate market costs while only postponing the arrival of biological risks. This paper evaluates that intertemporal tradeoff using the 2024–2025 US suspension of live cattle imports from Mexico in response to the northward spread of New World Screwworm (NWS). We estimate a vector autoregression (VAR) using monthly data from 2004 to 2025 to characterize pre‐ban dynamics in feeder cattle prices, Mexican import volumes, fed cattle prices, and feed costs, and construct counterfactual forecasts for prices and trade flows absent the border closures. Translating these costs into a simple break‐even framework shows that under an annual endemic‐loss assumption of $10 billion, each additional month of border closure would need to delay endemic NWS establishment by approximately 4 months to be welfare improving.
abstract_zh: 摘要 生物安全贸易限制通常被视为预防性措施，但在许多情境下，它们主要发挥延迟政策的作用：这些限制在施加即时市场成本的同时，仅能推迟生物风险的到来。本文利用2024-2025年美国因新世界螺旋蝇（NWS）向北蔓延而暂停从墨西哥进口活牛的案例，评估了这一跨期权衡。我们基于2004年至2025年的月度数据，估计了一个向量自回归（VAR）模型，以刻画禁运前架子牛价格、墨西哥进口量、育肥牛价格及饲料成本之间的动态关系，并构建了无边境关闭情形下价格与贸易流的反事实预测。将这些成本转化为简单的盈亏平衡框架后显示，在每年10亿美元的地方性损失假设下，边境关闭每延长一个月，需将NWS地方性建立推迟约4个月，才能实现福利改善。
title: Delaying the Inevitable? U.S. Screwworm Closures and Feeder Cattle Market Dynamics
title_zh: 推迟不可避免之事？美国螺旋蝇检疫封锁与架子牛市场动态

abstract: We propose a method to identify the anticipated components of macroeconomic shocks in a structural VAR. We include empirical forecasts about each time series in the VAR. This introduces enough linear restrictions to identify every structural shock and to further decompose each one into “news” and “surprise” shocks. We estimate a VAR on U.S. time series using forecast data from the SPF, CBO, Federal Reserve, and asset prices. Unanticipated fiscal stimulus and monetary policy shocks have typical effects that match existing evidence. In our news‐surprise decomposition, we find that news drives around one quarter of U.S. business cycle volatility. News explains a larger share of the variance due to fiscal shocks than for monetary policy shocks. Finally, we use the news structure of the shocks to estimate counterfactual policy rules, and compare the ability of fiscal and monetary policy to moderate output and inflation. We find that coordinated fiscal and monetary policy are substantially more effective than either individually.
abstract_zh: 摘要 本文提出一种在结构向量自回归（VAR）中识别宏观经济冲击预期成分的方法。我们将各时间序列的经验预测纳入VAR模型，由此引入足够的线性约束，从而识别所有结构性冲击，并进一步将每个冲击分解为“新闻”冲击与“意外”冲击。我们利用美国国会预算办公室（CBO）、美联储、资产价格及专业预测者调查（SPF）的预测数据，对美国时间序列进行VAR估计。研究发现，未预期的财政刺激与货币政策冲击的典型效应与既有证据一致。在新闻-意外分解中，新闻冲击解释了美国经济周期波动约四分之一的方差。相较于货币政策冲击，新闻冲击对财政冲击方差的解释份额更大。最后，我们利用冲击的新闻结构估计反事实政策规则，并比较财政政策与货币政策在平抑产出与通胀方面的效力。结果表明，财政与货币政策的协调配合比单一政策显著更有效。
title: Identifying News Shocks From Forecasts
title_zh: 从预测中识别新闻冲击

abstract: This paper proposes the first methodology for assessing local determinacy in incomplete-markets models. My simple determinacy criterion yields theoretical results and can be verified numerically. It merely requires calculating aggregate marginal propensities to consume (MPC) and aggregate elasticities of asset demand. I find that the policy rules ensuring determinacy can be quite different in incomplete as opposed to complete-markets models. My methodology can thus avoid the current (flawed) practice of referring to complete markets results to assess determinacy in incomplete markets models. The main findings are: If bonds are nominal, the economy is always determinate for a constant nominal interest rate or for price level targeting if prices are sufficiently rigid. The model is indeterminate if fiscal policy is too expansionary, requiring a monetary policy response to reestablish determinacy. If bonds are real, whether or not the Taylor principle induces determinacy depends non-linearly on MPCs, the degree of price rigidities and whether interest rates respond to output. I also find the determinacy properties of active and passive fiscal rules (Leeper, 1991) to be different in incomplete and complete markets models. I explain the shortcomings in Kaplan et al. (2023), which are the reason for their different and thus invalid findings.
abstract_zh: 本文提出了在不完全市场模型中评估局部确定性的首个方法论。这一简洁的确定性准则既能推导出理论结果，也可通过数值方法验证，仅需计算总边际消费倾向（MPC）与总资产需求弹性。研究发现，相较于完全市场模型，不完全市场模型中确保确定性的政策规则可能存在显著差异。因此，本方法论可避免当前（存在缺陷的）将完全市场结论套用于不完全市场模型确定性评估的实践。主要发现如下：若债券为名义债券，在名义利率恒定或价格水平目标制下（当价格具有充分刚性时），经济始终具有确定性；若财政政策过度扩张，模型将出现不确定性，此时需通过货币政策响应重建确定性。若债券为实际债券，泰勒原理能否引发确定性取决于MPC、价格刚性程度及利率是否对产出做出反应的非线性关系。此外，本文发现主动与被动财政规则（Leeper, 1991）在完全市场与不完全市场模型中的确定性特征存在差异，并阐释了Kaplan等（2023）研究中的缺陷——正是这些缺陷导致其结论存在差异且无效。
journal: Journal of Economic Dynamics and Control

title: Local Determinacy in Incomplete-Markets Models
title_zh: 不完全市场模型中的局部确定性

abstract: The Panic of 1825 was a significant crisis in British financial history. We document how this crisis spread from London banks to England’s real economy. England’s correspondent banking network propagated trouble in sovereign debt markets to small banks outside of London and ultimately to non-financial firms. Using exogenous variation in district-level exposure to the crisis, we show that bank failures led to a substantial number of bankruptcies among non-financial firms. We discuss two potential mechanisms by which the financial system affected the real economy: a fall in aggregate demand and a credit supply shock.
abstract_zh: 1825年恐慌是英国金融史上一次重大危机。本文记录了这场危机如何从伦敦银行蔓延至英格兰实体经济。英格兰的代理银行网络将主权债务市场的困境传导至伦敦以外的小型银行，并最终波及非金融企业。利用各地区危机暴露程度的外生差异，我们证明银行倒闭导致非金融企业破产数量大幅增加。本文探讨了金融体系影响实体经济的两种潜在机制：总需求下降与信贷供给冲击。
title: Country banks and the Panic of 1825
title_zh: 乡村银行与1825年恐慌

abstract: The digitalisation of tax payments is a growing policy priority in low- and middle-income countries, particularly in Africa, where revenue mobilisation remains a challenge. This study examines the impact of digital tax payments on compliance, leveraging a 2021 zero-cash-handling mandate in Eswatini. Using administrative tax data, we evaluate two key questions: (i) how voluntary adoption of digital payments affects compliance and (ii) the impact of mandating digital tax payments. We employ a staggered difference-in-differences (DiD) approach for voluntary adoption and a treatment-intensity DiD strategy to assess the mandate’s effects. Voluntary adoption significantly improves compliance, reducing late payments by 19–20% points (25–30 per cent reduction) and increasing payment accuracy (paying the tax liability in full) by 5.6% points (20 per cent), but for strictly digital payments only. Effects on tax amounts paid are less consistent, but the fully controlled broad-digital specification implies an increase of approximately 32%. The mandate, by contrast, eliminated cash payments and is associated with an approximately 17% increase in tax paid on average. While companies pay more taxes, they also worsen their payment accuracy, while individuals are more likely to pay their tax liabilities in full after adoption. These findings highlight distinct compliance patterns between voluntary adopters and those compelled by enforcement. The results underscore the importance of designing digital tax policies that account for taxpayer heterogeneity and behavioural responses to maximise compliance gains.
abstract_zh: 税收支付数字化是低收入和中等收入国家日益重要的政策优先事项，尤其是在税收动员仍面临挑战的非洲地区。本研究利用斯威士兰2021年实施的"零现金处理"强制令，考察数字税收支付对税收遵从的影响。基于行政税收数据，我们评估两个关键问题：（i）自愿采用数字支付如何影响税收遵从；（ii）强制推行数字税收支付的影响。针对自愿采用行为，我们采用交错双重差分法；针对强制令效果，则采用处理强度双重差分策略。自愿采用显著改善税收遵从：严格数字支付场景下，逾期支付率降低19-20个百分点（降幅25-30%），支付准确性（全额缴纳税款）提升5.6个百分点（增幅20%）。对实缴税额的影响虽不一致，但完全控制的广义数字支付模型显示增幅约为32%。相比之下，强制令彻底消除了现金支付，平均实缴税额增加约17%。企业虽缴纳更多税款，但支付准确性下降；而个人在采用后更可能全额缴纳税款。这些发现揭示了自愿采用者与强制遵从者之间的差异化遵从模式。研究结果强调，数字税收政策设计需考虑纳税人异质性与行为反应，以最大化税收遵从收益。
publisher: Springer Science and Business Media LLC
title: Cashless tax systems: voluntary vs. mandated digital payments in Eswatini
title_zh: 无现金税收系统：斯威士兰自愿与强制数字支付的比较

abstract: This paper examines the impact of immigration on natives' social trust in the context of China's mass internal migration. Combining individual-level information on social trust and county-level information on immigration rate, we employ the instrumental variable strategy and find that immigration has a significant negative impact on trust among native residents. The impact of immigration on trust is more salient for trust in weak ties than trust in strong ties, and from a compositional perspective, the impact of low-skilled immigrants is more salient than that of high-skilled immigrants. Additional analyses suggest that better public services can buffer the impact of immigration on trust, implying a key role in public policy.
abstract_zh: 本文以中国大规模内部人口迁移为背景，考察移民对本地居民社会信任的影响。通过结合个体层面的社会信任数据与县级层面的移民率信息，采用工具变量策略发现：移民对本地居民的社会信任具有显著的负向影响。从信任类型来看，移民对弱关系信任的冲击强于强关系信任；从移民结构来看，低技能移民的影响比高技能移民更为显著。进一步分析表明，更优质的公共服务能够缓冲移民对信任的冲击，这揭示了公共政策在此过程中的关键作用。

abstract: We study structural change in production networks for intermediate inputs (inputoutput network) and new capital (investment network). For each network, we document that the share of output produced by services (relative to goods) is rising over time. While the relative prices of services that produce intermediates and consumption are rising, we find that the relative price of services that produce investment is falling over time. We then develop a multi-sector growth model to study these trends and their implications for economic growth. To match the relative price trends, inputs to intermediates production are complements and inputs to investment production are substitutes. Hence, structural change endogenously reallocates resources to the slowest growing intermediates producers and the fastest growing investment producers. Growth accounting exercises reveal that investment-specific technical change accounts for an increasing share of U.S. aggregate growth, with 20% of aggregate growth since 2000 due to investment structural change. Growth projections from our model show that structural change within investment networks alone can offset stagnating or declining growth in other sectors due to Baumol’s cost disease.
abstract_zh: 摘要 本文研究了中间投入品生产网络（投入产出网络）与资本品生产网络（投资网络）中的结构变迁。对于每个网络，我们观察到服务业产出（相对于商品）的份额随时间推移持续上升。尽管生产中间品和消费品的服务业相对价格在上升，但生产投资品的服务业相对价格却在下降。为此，我们构建了一个多部门增长模型来分析这些趋势及其对经济增长的影响。为匹配相对价格变化趋势，中间品生产投入呈现互补性，而投资品生产投入则呈现替代性。因此，结构变迁内生地将资源重新配置给增长最慢的中间品生产部门与增长最快的投资品生产部门。增长核算表明，投资专用型技术进步在美国总体增长中的贡献份额持续上升，其中2000年以来20%的总体增长源于投资结构变迁。模型增长预测显示，仅投资网络内部的结构变迁即可抵消鲍莫尔成本病导致的其他部门增长停滞或下降效应。
title: Structural Change in Production Networks and Economic Growth
title_zh: 生产网络中的结构变化与经济增长

abstract: This study investigates the upward intergenerational effects of adult children's high-level human capital accumulation on their older parents' risky behaviors. By exploiting the large-scale higher education expansion in China and applying the Treatment Effects Model, we find that children's higher education leads to a significant reduction in their parents' cigarette smoking. However, such effects cannot be found when it comes to an education increase triggered by the compulsory education popularization. These behavior-modifying effects are more pronounced among fathers and less advantaged families, and sons and firstborns within the family play a more effective role in generating such effects. Further evidence is provided for several underlying mechanisms, including increased security in life, more health knowledge, and rural-to-urban migration for older parents. Our findings indicate an about 8.41% contribution to the declining smoking prevalence since the late 1990s, and also imply narrowing health inequality among the older population in the long run.
abstract_zh: 本研究探讨了成年子女高水平人力资本积累对老年父母风险行为的向上代际影响。利用中国大规模高等教育扩张，并应用处理效应模型，我们发现子女接受高等教育显著减少了父母吸烟行为。然而，由义务教育普及引发的教育提升并未产生此类效应。这些行为改变效应在父亲及弱势家庭中更为显著，且家庭中的儿子和长子/长女在产生此类效应中扮演更有效的角色。进一步证据揭示了若干潜在机制，包括生活安全感增强、健康知识增加以及老年父母从农村向城市迁移。我们的研究结果表明，自20世纪90年代末以来，这一效应约占吸烟率下降的8.41%，并长期内意味着老年人口健康不平等状况的缩小。

abstract: Focus In January 2023, Colombia introduced new banking rules. These rules required banks to set aside more money to cover risks from long-term consumer loans. The goal was to reduce risks tied to lending with long repayment periods, especially during a time of strong credit growth. This paper looks at how these changes affected banks and their lending practices.
abstract_zh: 2023年1月，哥伦比亚出台了新的银行业监管规定。这些规定要求银行拨备更多资金，以覆盖长期消费贷款的风险。其目标是在信贷高速增长时期，降低与长期限贷款相关的风险。本文考察了这些政策变化对银行及其贷款行为的影响。
title: Assessing the effects of recent provisioning rules on consumer credit allocation in Colombia

abstract: We build a novel data set of time-stamped corporate decarbonization commitments—green pledges—for U.S. public firms by classifying news articles with large language models and human validation. Firms announcing green pledges tend to be larger and browner than other firms, both within and across industries. Green pledges significantly raise stock prices, consistent with a reduction in the carbon premium, and predict sizable declines in future carbon emissions and emission intensities. These effects tend to be strongest for firms in brown industries. Green pledges thus appear credible, convey relevant new information to investors, and provide meaningful financial incentives to decarbonize. (JEL G14, G32, Q54, Q56)
abstract_zh: 摘要 我们通过利用大语言模型对新闻文章进行分类并结合人工验证，构建了一个包含美国上市公司时间戳企业脱碳承诺（绿色承诺）的新数据集。无论行业内部还是跨行业，发布绿色承诺的企业通常规模更大且碳排放强度更高。绿色承诺显著推高了股票价格，这与碳溢价的降低相一致，并预示着未来碳排放量和排放强度的大幅下降。这些效应在棕色行业的企业中最为显著。因此，绿色承诺具有可信度，向投资者传递了相关的新信息，并为脱碳提供了有意义的财务激励。（JEL G14, G32, Q54, Q56）
title: Corporate Green Pledges
title_zh: 企业绿色承诺

abstract: This paper empirically investigates the causal effect of subsidies on reshoring in Taiwan. The Taiwanese government has provided subsidies to Taiwanese firms to encourage them to relocate their factories from China back to Taiwan. Using the matched data between firm-level business information and the list of subsidy recipients from 2016 to 2023, we investigate how subsidy recipients change their behavior in both China and Taiwan. To mitigate the bias introduced by the selection mechanism in this subsidy, we employ the doubly robust difference-in-differences method. As a result, we found that this subsidy program has not induced reshoring or relocation of export base from China to Taiwan. Although some recipients expanded their production facilities and increased domestic sales, these changes were not significant enough to increase production and employment in Taiwan. These findings suggest that financial incentives alone are insufficient to offset the structural advantages of established production networks in China.
abstract_zh: 本文实证研究了补贴对台湾地区企业回迁的因果效应。台湾当局向本地企业提供补贴，鼓励其将工厂从中国大陆迁回台湾。通过匹配2016至2023年间企业层面商业信息与补贴接收方名单的数据，我们考察了补贴接收方在中国大陆和台湾地区的行为变化。为缓解该补贴选择机制带来的偏误，我们采用双重稳健双重差分法。结果表明，该补贴计划并未促使企业从中国大陆向台湾回迁或转移出口基地。尽管部分受补贴企业扩大了生产设施并增加了内销，但这些变化尚不足以显著提升台湾地区的生产与就业。这些发现表明，仅凭财政激励不足以抵消中国大陆成熟生产网络的结构性优势。

abstract: This paper examines the joint role of strategic timing, asymmetric private demand and cost information, and common ownership in shaping equilibrium outcomes in oligopolistic markets. We develop a three‐firm model and study Cournot and Stackelberg competition. The main results are as follows. (1) Mover advantages are determined by relative signal precision: the leader benefits most when the second mover has a more precise signal, the second mover benefits most when the last mover has high signal precision, and the last mover benefits when both followers have sufficiently noisy signals. (2) Cournot competition generates greater consumer and total surplus and lower total profits than Stackelberg competition if neither follower has significantly higher signal precision than the leader. (3) Common ownership increases consumer and total surplus but reduces total profits in Stackelberg competition if and only if the last mover is not substantially better informed than the leader. These findings have implications for contests, partnership, network, public good, common resource, and gas emission games with altruistic preferences. Since total profit in oligopoly models can be interpreted as aggregate welfare in these environments, the welfare rankings are reversed.
abstract_zh: 摘要 本文研究了战略时机、非对称私有需求与成本信息以及共同所有权在寡头垄断市场均衡结果中的联合作用。我们构建了一个三企业模型，并分析了古诺竞争与斯塔克伯格竞争。主要结论如下：（1）先动优势取决于相对信号精度：当后动者拥有更精确的信号时，先动者获益最大；当最后动者信号精度较高时，第二动者获益最大；当两个追随者的信号均足够模糊时，最后动者获益最大。（2）若任一追随者的信号精度未显著高于先动者，古诺竞争比斯塔克伯格竞争能带来更高的消费者剩余与总剩余，但总利润更低。（3）在斯塔克伯格竞争中，当且仅当最后动者的信息优势未显著超过先动者时，共同所有权会提升消费者剩余与总剩余，但降低总利润。这些发现对存在利他偏好的竞赛、合伙、网络、公共品、公共资源及气体排放博弈具有启示意义。由于寡头模型中的总利润可被解释为这些环境中的总福利，福利排序将发生逆转。
title: Simultaneous and Sequential Competition With Asymmetric Information and Externalities

abstract: We introduce Multiplicative Modular Nim (MuM), a variant of Nim in which the traditional nim-sum is replaced by heap-size multiplication modulo m. We establish a complete theory for this game, beginning with a direct, Bouton-style analysis for prime moduli. abstract: Urban green spaces (UGSs) are critical for ecological sustainability, social wellbeing, public health, and urban livability, yet they are increasingly threatened in rapidly urbanising cities. This study employed a qualitative case study approach to examine the condition of urban green spaces and the socio-ecological and governance processes driving their decline in five communities within the Greater Tamale Metropolitan Area (GTMA): Gumbehene, Nyohini, Kukuo, Taha, and Sagnarigu. Data were collected through in-depth semi-structured interviews with residents, community leaders, planning officials, landowners, and other stakeholders involved in land governance, complemented by field observations of green space distribution, quality, accessibility, and use. The data were analysed thematically through systematic coding and categorisation of interview transcripts and field notes to identify recurring patterns, key drivers, and governance challenges associated with green space decline. The findings reveal significant deterioration of UGSs, characterised by inadequate provision, poor maintenance, safety concerns, and increasing inaccessibility. This decline is driven by interconnected factors, including rapid population growth and horizontal urban expansion into green and open spaces, the commercialisation of customary land, weak planning enforcement, fragmented institutional responsibilities, and political interference. Together, these processes prioritise short-term economic and political interests over long-term ecological sustainability and community wellbeing, resulting in inequitable access to green spaces and the gradual erosion of their ecological, social, and public health functions. By foregrounding local perspectives and lived experiences, the study offers actionable insights for promoting sustainable, resilient, and inclusive urban planning and green space governance in the GTMA and other rapidly urbanising contexts facing similar challenges.
abstract_zh: 城市绿色空间（UGS）对生态可持续性、社会福祉、公共健康及城市宜居性至关重要，然而在快速城市化的城市中，它们正日益受到威胁。本研究采用定性案例研究方法，考察了大塔马利都市区（GTMA）内五个社区（古姆贝赫内、尼约希尼、库库奥、塔哈和萨格纳里古）城市绿色空间的状况及其衰退背后的社会生态与治理过程。数据通过深入半结构化访谈收集，访谈对象包括居民、社区领袖、规划官员、土地所有者及其他参与土地治理的利益相关者，并辅以对绿色空间分布、质量、可达性和使用情况的实地观察。数据通过系统编码和分类访谈记录及实地笔记进行主题分析，以识别与绿色空间衰退相关的重复模式、关键驱动因素和治理挑战。研究结果揭示了城市绿色空间的显著退化，表现为供给不足、维护不善、安全隐患及可达性日益降低。这一衰退由相互关联的因素驱动，包括人口快速增长和水平城市扩张侵占绿色及开放空间、习惯土地的商品化、规划执法薄弱、机构职责分散以及政治干预。这些过程共同将短期经济和政治利益置于长期生态可持续性和社区福祉之上，导致绿色空间获取的不平等以及其生态、社会和公共健康功能的逐步侵蚀。通过突出地方视角和生活经验，本研究为促进GTMA及其他面临类似挑战的快速城市化背景下可持续、有韧性和包容性的城市规划及绿色空间治理提供了可操作的见解。
title: The political ecology of urban green space transformation in Greater Tamale, Ghana: Conditions, drivers, and power relations

abstract: In a data economy, transactions of goods and services generate data, which is stored, traded and depreciates. How are the economics of this economy different from traditional production economies? How do these differences matter for measurement of GDP, firm values, depreciation rates, welfare and externalities? We incorporate active experimentation and data as an intangible asset to devise a tractable recursive representation of the data economy. The model rationalizes why apps are often “free” and why even non-digital economic activity might be greater than GDP suggests. Calibrating the model using a combination of macroeconomic and financial moments suggests that the mis-measurement in U.S. GDP due to missing value of data has been as high as 6% in 2018.
abstract_zh: 在数据经济中，商品和服务的交易会产生数据，这些数据被存储、交易并发生折旧。这种经济体的经济学特征与传统生产经济体有何不同？这些差异如何影响GDP、企业价值、折旧率、福利和外部性的衡量？我们通过引入主动实验和将数据视为无形资产，构建了一个可处理的数据经济递归表示模型。该模型解释了为何应用程序通常“免费”，以及为何即使非数字经济活动也可能大于GDP所显示的水平。结合宏观经济和金融数据的校准结果表明，2018年因数据价值缺失导致的美国GDP测量误差高达6%。
title: A Model of the Data Economy
title_zh: 数据经济模型

abstract: The balance between environmental protection and socioeconomic development remains a critical policy challenge. Conservation efforts may constrain local development but can also generate benefits beyond nature protection itself, with effects varying across protection regimes and spatial scales. Poland provides a compelling case for examining this trade-off, given its rapid economic growth alongside the significant expansion of protected areas (PAs) in recent decades. This study assesses the relationship between nature protection regimes and local development across Polish municipalities between 2009 and 2022. Using spatial econometric modelling (Spatial Durbin Error Model), we estimate the direct and indirect effects of national parks, nature reserves, and Natura 2000 sites on three dimensions of local development: economic, social, and infrastructural. The most consistent positive effects are observed for economic development in municipalities with a high share of national parks and Natura 2000 sites. Infrastructure-related effects are limited: only Natura 2000 areas show a positive direct effect, while negative indirect effects suggest regional competition for investment. Social impacts are predominantly negative, particularly for stricter protection regimes, and extend beyond administrative boundaries, likely reflecting integrated labour markets. These findings challenge the notion that conservation uniformly constrains economic development. Instead, they indicate that outcomes vary by protection regime and that benefits are unevenly distributed, supporting local economic growth while reinforcing social exclusion. The study underscores the need for policies that mitigate social costs and promote more equitable and territorially integrated development under expanding conservation efforts. abstract_zh: 环境保护与社会经济发展之间的平衡仍是一项关键的政策挑战。保护工作可能制约地方发展，但也可能产生超越自然保护本身的效益，且其影响因保护制度与空间尺度而异。波兰为考察这一权衡提供了典型案例，因其近年来经济快速增长的同时，保护区面积显著扩大。本研究评估了2009年至2022年间波兰各市镇自然保护制度与地方发展之间的关系。运用空间计量经济模型（空间杜宾误差模型），我们估算了国家公园、自然保护区及Natura 2000保护区对地方发展三个维度——经济、社会与基础设施——的直接与间接效应。最一致的正向效应出现在国家公园和Natura 2000保护区占比较高的市镇，其经济发展表现突出。基础设施相关效应有限：仅Natura 2000区域呈现正向直接效应，而负向间接效应则暗示区域间存在投资竞争。社会影响以负面为主，尤其在更严格的保护制度下，且影响超越行政边界，可能反映了劳动力市场的一体化特征。这些发现挑战了保护工作普遍制约经济发展的观点。相反，它们表明结果因保护制度而异，且效益分配不均，在支撑地方经济增长的同时加剧了社会排斥。本研究强调，在保护范围不断扩大的背景下，亟需制定相关政策以缓解社会成本，促进更加公平且区域一体化的协调发展。图形摘要 下载：下载高分辨率图片（200KB） 下载：下载全尺寸图片

abstract: Forests are central to rural livelihoods in Zambia’s Miombo landscapes, providing energy, food, materials, and income. Yet forest-use restrictions may affect households differently depending on market access, enforcement, and livelihood opportunities. This study examines how restricted and non-restricted forest management regimes shape household livelihood strategies in Copperbelt, Eastern, and North-Western provinces. Using survey data from 1115 households, cluster analysis identified forest livelihood strategies, while multinomial logit models estimated adjusted probabilities of strategy membership and associated household drivers. Four strategies were identified: Low-Monetisation Unprocessed Forest Products Dependents, Unprocessed Forest Products Subsistence Diversifiers, Charcoal-Oriented Mixed households, and Charcoal-Cash Specialists. Regime effects varied strongly by province. In Eastern Province, restricted landscapes increased Low-Monetisation dependence by 43.76 %age points and reduced Charcoal-Cash specialisation by 29.94 points. In North-Western Province, restrictions increased Low-Monetisation dependence by 35.11 points but reduced Charcoal-Oriented Mixed strategies by 31.40 points. In the Copperbelt, the pattern differed: restricted landscapes increased Charcoal-Cash specialisation by 9.80 points and Charcoal-Oriented Mixed strategies by 14.26 points, while reducing subsistence diversification by 26.03 points. Household education, gender, livestock ownership, landholding, residence duration, road access, and regime interactions also shaped strategy membership. The findings show that forest-use restrictions do not produce uniform livelihood outcomes. Instead, they operate as context-dependent filters, reinforcing subsistence dependence in some settings while coexisting with charcoal commercialisation in market-integrated landscapes. Effective governance requires spatially differentiated policy mixes combining conservation, enforcement, energy alternatives, tenure clarity, and livelihood support.
abstract_zh: 森林是赞比亚米奥博林地农村生计的核心，提供能源、食物、材料和收入。然而，森林使用限制可能因市场准入、执法力度和生计机会的不同而对家庭产生差异化影响。本研究考察了限制性与非限制性森林管理制度如何塑造铜带省、东部省和西北省的家庭生计策略。基于1115户家庭的调查数据，聚类分析识别出森林生计策略，而多项逻辑模型则估计了策略归属的调整后概率及其相关家庭驱动因素。研究识别出四种策略：低货币化未加工林产品依赖型、未加工林产品生计多样化型、木炭导向混合型以及木炭现金专业化型。制度效应因省份而异。在东部省，限制性景观使低货币化依赖型策略增加43.76个百分点，同时使木炭现金专业化型策略减少29.94个百分点。在西北省，限制性景观使低货币化依赖型策略增加35.11个百分点，但使木炭导向混合型策略减少31.40个百分点。在铜带省，模式有所不同：限制性景观使木炭现金专业化型策略增加9.80个百分点，木炭导向混合型策略增加14.26个百分点，同时使生计多样化型策略减少26.03个百分点。家庭受教育程度、性别、牲畜拥有量、土地持有量、居住时长、道路通达性及制度交互作用也影响策略归属。研究结果表明，森林使用限制并未产生统一的生计结果，而是作为情境依赖的过滤器，在某些环境中强化生计依赖，同时在市场整合的景观中与木炭商业化共存。有效的治理需要结合保护、执法、能源替代、权属明确和生计支持的空间差异化政策组合。
title: Forest livelihood strategies under contrasting management regimes: Evidence from the Copperbelt, Eastern and North-Western Provinces of Zambia
title_zh: 不同管理机制下的森林生计策略：来自赞比亚铜带省、东部省和西北省的证据

abstract: We study productivity shocks in a New Keynesian model with endogenous entry, selection, and nominal rigidities. Adjustment along the extensive margin fundamentally alters the transmission of TFP shocks. Under sticky prices, productivity disturbances generate a large “entry multiplier”: firm entry-exit responds much more strongly than under flexible prices, even when output is allocatively efficient to first order. Introducing wage stickiness breaks this neutrality. Adverse TFP shocks reduce profits, trigger exit, and generate a negative output gap while remaining inflationary. Productivity shocks therefore behave as true supply shocks, without resorting to ad hoc cost-push or markup disturbances. Unlike standard markup shocks, TFP shocks in our framework imply procyclical profits and entry, consistent with the data. When wages are sufficiently sticky, expansionary monetary policy raises entry, closes the negative output gap, and improves welfare. The model remains analytically tractable and isomorphic to the standard New Keynesian framework, with entry and selection appearing as simple wedges.
abstract_zh: 我们研究了一个包含内生进入、选择效应和名义刚性的新凯恩斯模型中的生产率冲击。沿扩展边际的调整从根本上改变了全要素生产率冲击的传导机制。在价格粘性条件下，生产率扰动会产生巨大的"进入乘数"效应：即使产出在一阶条件下达到配置效率，企业进入与退出对生产率冲击的反应仍远强于灵活价格情形。引入工资粘性会打破这种中性效应。不利的全要素生产率冲击会降低利润、引发企业退出，并在保持通胀压力的同时产生负向产出缺口。因此，生产率冲击无需借助特设的成本推动或加成率扰动，即可表现为真正的供给冲击。与标准加成率冲击不同，我们框架中的全要素生产率冲击意味着顺周期的利润与进入行为，这与数据特征一致。当工资粘性足够强时，扩张性货币政策能够促进企业进入、缩小负向产出缺口并提升社会福利。该模型保持解析可处理性，且与标准新凯恩斯框架同构，其中进入与选择效应以简单楔子形式呈现。

abstract: Land degradation remains a major challenge to rural livelihoods and ecosystem sustainability across sub-Saharan Africa, with restoration efforts increasingly recognized as both ecological and governance challenges. While growing attention has been paid to gender-responsive restoration, limited research has examined how gendered land governance systems, tenure relations, and socio-ecological contexts shape perceptions of degradation and restoration practices. This study assessed gendered dimensions of land degradation and restoration across two contrasting agroecological zones in Cameroon, Pitoa in the Sudano-Sahelian zone and Balatchi in the humid Western Highlands. Using a mixed-methods approach combining household surveys (n = 320), participatory biophysical assessments using the Land Degradation Surveillance Framework (LDSF), and geospatial analysis, the study examined perceptions of degradation, restoration practices, training participation, and factors influencing restoration adoption among male and female land users. The findings reveal both shared and differentiated perceptions of land degradation between men and women. While there was moderate overall agreement on degradation drivers (Kendall's coefficient of concordance (wt) = 0.64), low within-gender scores (wt = 0.30 for both men and women) highlight substantial intra-group variation. This suggests that gender alone cannot explain the full diversity of perceptions; other intersecting factors, such as age, tenure, education, and livelihood, likely shape individual viewpoints. Women showed stronger engagement in restoration practices linked to soil fertility improvement, including crop rotation, organic manure application, and agroforestry, while men more frequently emphasized market-oriented and input-intensive strategies. However, restoration decisions were strongly shaped not only by gender roles, but also by unequal access to land, labour, financial resources, training opportunities, and decision-making power. The study further demonstrates that access to land does not necessarily translate into secure control over land or restoration benefits, particularly for women operating under customary tenure systems. The results highlight the importance of integrating gender-responsive and rights-based governance approaches into restoration policy and practice. Effective restoration requires not only ecological rehabilitation, but also strengthened tenure security, inclusive participation, and equitable access to restoration resources and benefits. By linking biophysical assessment with gendered land governance analysis, the study contributes to emerging debates on socially inclusive and sustainable land restoration in sub-Saharan Africa. abstract_zh: 土地退化仍然是撒哈拉以南非洲农村生计和生态系统可持续性面临的重大挑战，恢复工作日益被视为既涉及生态问题又涉及治理问题的双重挑战。尽管性别响应的恢复日益受到关注，但关于性别化的土地治理体系、产权关系和社会-生态背景如何塑造人们对退化及恢复实践的认知，相关研究仍然有限。本研究评估了喀麦隆两个截然不同的农业生态区——苏丹-萨赫勒带的Pitoa和湿润西部高地的Balatchi——中土地退化与恢复的性别维度。研究采用混合方法，结合农户调查（n = 320）、基于土地退化监测框架（LDSF）的参与式生物物理评估以及地理空间分析，考察了男性和女性土地使用者对退化的认知、恢复实践、培训参与以及影响恢复采纳的因素。研究结果揭示了男性和女性对土地退化的认知既有共性也存在差异。尽管对退化驱动因素的总体一致性中等（Kendall和谐系数（wt）= 0.64），但性别内部的低一致性得分（男性和女性均为wt = 0.30）凸显了群体内部的显著差异。这表明性别本身无法完全解释认知的多样性；年龄、产权、教育程度和生计等其他交叉因素可能共同塑造个体观点。女性在涉及土壤肥力改善的恢复实践中表现出更强的参与度，包括作物轮作、有机肥施用和农林业，而男性则更倾向于强调市场导向和投入密集型策略。然而，恢复决策不仅受到性别角色的强烈影响，还受到土地、劳动力、资金资源、培训机会和决策权力获取不平等的制约。研究进一步表明，土地获取并不必然转化为对土地或恢复收益的安全控制，尤其是在习惯产权制度下经营的女性群体中尤为明显。研究结果强调了将性别响应和基于权利的治理方法纳入恢复政策和实践的重要性。有效的恢复不仅需要生态修复，还需要加强产权保障、促进包容性参与，并确保恢复资源和收益的公平获取。通过将生物物理评估与性别化土地治理分析相结合，本研究为撒哈拉以南非洲社会包容性和可持续土地恢复的新兴讨论做出了贡献。图形摘要下载：见原文
title: The gendered effects of agricultural practices on land degradation and restoration in two contrasting agro-ecological zones of Cameroon
title_zh: 喀麦隆两个对比农业生态区中农业实践对土地退化和恢复的性别化影响

abstract: This study analyses the creation of La Réunion National Park (2002–2007) as a strategic and competitive political process embedded within a formal conservation planning framework. Drawing on Evolutionary Governance Theory (EGT), it shows how boundary delineation functioned as a governance instrument that reconfigured power relations between the French state and the Regional Council within a post-colonial, multi-level European outermost context marked by socio-environmental vulnerability and claims for regional autonomy. Combining GIS-based spatial analysis, archival research, and semi-structured interviews, the study traces the co-evolution of actors, institutions, discourses, knowledge, and material instruments throughout the park’s spatial planning process. Results, structured along five EGT analytical axes, indicate that boundary delineation constituted a strategic governance process rather than a purely technical exercise. Environmental planning emerged as a political arena in which power relations between the French state and the Regional Council were renegotiated. Scientific expertise and digital tools played a central role in legitimising decisions. Simultaneously, they contributed to filtering and hierarchising competing territorial claims. Participatory processes were formally inclusive but tightly managed, enabling consultation without substantially altering predefined outcomes and resulting in limited boundary changes. Finally, despite stated autonomy-oriented objectives, environmental planning contributed to the production of new social and spatial inequalities, highlighting the ambivalent role of conservation policies in island governance: ensuring both protection and external territorial control. More broadly, the study demonstrates how conservation planning operates as a governance instrument that shapes and reveals land values and power distribution. These findings suggest that boundary delineation should be explicitly treated as a political and governance instrument, requiring greater transparency, stronger accountability, and more substantive inclusion of local actors to avoid reinforcing existing power asymmetries in spatial planning.
abstract_zh: 本研究分析了留尼汪国家公园（2002–2007年）的创建过程，将其视为嵌入正式保护规划框架中的战略性与竞争性政治进程。基于演化治理理论（EGT），研究揭示了边界划定如何作为一种治理工具，在面临社会-环境脆弱性与区域自治诉求的后殖民、多层级欧洲最外围地区，重构法国国家与地区议会之间的权力关系。通过结合地理信息系统空间分析、档案研究与半结构化访谈，本研究追溯了公园空间规划过程中行动者、制度、话语、知识与物质工具的协同演化。依据EGT五大分析维度呈现的结果表明，边界划定构成了一种战略性治理过程，而非纯粹的技术性操作。环境规划成为法国国家与地区议会重新协商权力关系的政治场域。科学专业知识与数字工具在决策合法化中发挥核心作用，同时亦对相互竞争的领土诉求进行筛选与等级化。参与过程形式上具有包容性，但受到严格管控，允许协商却未实质性改变预设结果，仅导致有限的边界调整。最终，尽管以自治为导向的目标被明确表述，环境规划却催生了新的社会与空间不平等，凸显了保护政策在岛屿治理中的矛盾角色：既确保保护，又强化外部领土控制。更广泛而言，本研究揭示了保护规划如何作为塑造并反映土地价值与权力分配的治理工具。这些发现表明，边界划定应被明确视为政治与治理工具，需要更高的透明度、更强的问责机制以及更实质性的地方行动者参与，以避免在空间规划中强化既有的权力不对称。
title: What boundary delineation reveals about island evolutionary governance: Multi-level power brokerage in Réunion National Park
title_zh: 边界划定揭示的岛屿演化治理：留尼汪国家公园的多层级权力中介

abstract: Although the U.S. alcohol industry is a major economic sector, alcohol consumption has long been associated with a wide range of detrimental health, social, and economic outcomes. Simultaneously, increasing land use conflicts and climate change-induced yield reductions are contributing to food insecurity. The purpose of this study is to evaluate a potential approach to addressing both the negative externalities of the alcohol industry and the growing problem of food insecurity by reconsidering agricultural land allocation – specifically, shifting land currently used for alcohol crops towards human food. For this land-use re-allocation, this study develops a new method by determining alcohol-related crop land area, caloric yield, and quantifies human feeding capacity for four scenarios: (i) lives saved by mitigating alcohol-related harms by elimination of alcohol consumption and (ii) additional lives that could be supported through increased caloric availability from food crops grown on the same land for hops, grapes, barley and corn for two scenarios: (iia) ingesting food directly rather than alcohol conversion and (iib) replanting with higher yield food crops. Eliminating U.S. alcohol could prevent an estimated 178,000 deaths/year. These life savings, however, were small compared to the implications for food security. Results showed repurposing (scenario iib) America’s alcohol-dedicated cropland to potato cultivation yields the greatest potential human feeding capacity – an estimated 641.65 million people annually, exceeding the baseline of eating alcohol crops directly by over 50%. Only 2.1% of American alcohol-related crops would need to be converted to eliminate global hunger-related mortality entirely. By making small land use changes to eliminate alcohol consumption in favor of food production, public health policy could eliminate human starvation globally and save millions of lives annually.
abstract_zh: 尽管美国酒精产业是一个重要的经济部门，但酒精消费长期以来与一系列有害的健康、社会和经济后果相关联。同时，日益加剧的土地利用冲突和气候变化引起的产量减少正导致粮食不安全问题。本研究旨在评估一种潜在方法，通过重新考虑农业土地分配——具体而言，将目前用于酒精作物的土地转向人类食物生产——来同时应对酒精产业的负面外部性和日益严重的粮食不安全问题。为此，本研究开发了一种新方法，通过确定与酒精相关的作物土地面积、卡路里产量，并量化四种情景下的人类供养能力：(i) 通过消除酒精消费减轻酒精相关危害而挽救的生命，以及(ii) 通过在同一土地上种植用于啤酒花、葡萄、大麦和玉米的粮食作物增加卡路里供应所能额外支持的生命，分为两种情景：(iia) 直接食用食物而非将其转化为酒精，以及(iib) 重新种植高产粮食作物。消除美国的酒精消费预计每年可防止约178,000人死亡。然而，与对粮食安全的影响相比，这些生命节省相对较小。结果显示，将美国专门用于酒精作物的农田重新用于马铃薯种植（情景iib）能产生最大的人类供养潜力——估计每年可供养6.4165亿人，比直接食用酒精作物的基线情景高出超过50%。仅需将美国与酒精相关作物的2.1%转化为粮食生产，即可完全消除全球与饥饿相关的死亡。通过微小的土地利用调整，以消除酒精消费并转向粮食生产，公共卫生政策可以在全球范围内消除人类饥饿，并每年挽救数百万人的生命。
title: Land use for alcohol production and its implications for food security and public health: A case study of the United States
title_zh: 酒精生产的土地利用及其对粮食安全和公共健康的影响：以美国为例

abstract: Academic collaboration is a key driver of innovation. Using international journal publication data, this study examines how transfers of university presidents among 111 prestigious public universities in China affect inter-university academic collaboration. Based on PPML estimates, we find that appointing a president to a university who has previously studied or worked at another university leads to an approximately 10% increase in the quantity of collaboration between the two institutions during the president’s period in office at the receiving university. In contrast, comparable transfers of university party secretaries do not generate such effects. The impact of presidential transfers is stronger for collaboration within the president’s own field of study, for university pairs that are geographically more distant, and for presidents who face stronger promotion incentives. In addition, presidential transfers stimulate collaboration regardless of whether the president’s current university or the connected university is listed as the first affiliation on a publication.
abstract_zh: 学术合作是创新的关键驱动力。本研究利用国际期刊发表数据，考察了中国111所重点公立大学校长流动对校际学术合作的影响。基于PPML估计，我们发现，任命一位曾在其他大学学习或工作的校长，在其任职期间，两校间的合作数量大约增加10%。相比之下，类似的大学党委书记调动并未产生此类效应。校长流动的影响在校长自身研究领域内的合作中更为显著，对于地理距离更远的大学配对以及面临更强晋升激励的校长而言，效果更为突出。此外，无论校长当前所在大学还是关联大学是否被列为论文的第一署名单位，校长流动均能促进合作。

title: Greasing the wheels of collaboration: Evidence from transfers of university presidents in China

abstract: We study the problem of fairly allocating indivisible goods and chores under category constraints. There are n agents and m items, partitioned into categories with capacity limits, and an allocation is feasible if every bundle respects these limits. For two agents, Shoshan et al. (2023) gave a polynomial-time algorithm for finding a Pareto-optimal allocation satisfying EF[1,1], a relaxed form of envy-freeness. Extending this beyond two agents was open. We show that for any number n of agents and any number k of categories, there exists a Pareto-optimal allocation such that each agent can be made envy-free by reallocating at most min { k + 1 , n } ( n − 1 ) items. We also give a polynomial-time algorithm for computing such an allocation when n is a constant. Our approach uses a new application of the Knaster-Kuratowski-Mazurkiewicz (KKM) lemma on a simplex of agent weights, which may be of independent interest.
abstract_zh: 我们研究在类别约束下公平分配不可分割物品与杂务的问题。设有n个代理和m个物品，这些物品被划分为具有容量限制的类别，若每个捆绑均遵守这些限制，则该分配是可行的。对于两个代理的情况，Shoshan等人（2023）提出了一种多项式时间算法，用于寻找满足EF[1,1]（一种放宽的无嫉妒形式）的帕累托最优分配。将此结果扩展到两个以上代理的问题此前尚未解决。我们证明，对于任意数量的代理n和任意数量的类别k，存在一种帕累托最优分配，使得每个代理通过重新分配至多min{k+1, n}(n−1)个物品即可实现无嫉妒状态。我们还给出了一种在n为常数时计算此类分配的多项式时间算法。我们的方法采用了Knaster-Kuratowski-Mazurkiewicz（KKM）引理在代理权重单纯形上的新应用，这可能具有独立的研究价值。
title: Fair and efficient allocation of indivisible items under category constraints
title_zh: 类别约束下不可分割物品的公平与有效分配

abstract: This paper investigates the transmission of oil price shocks to the banking sector in oil-dependent economies, using Oman as a case study. We develop a DSGE model featuring an integrated banking block with endogenous credit rationing and a sovereign wealth fund stabilization rule, calibrated to Omani institutional targets and disciplined by Bayesian methods. Our structural approach disentangles two primary transmission channels: the solvency channel, driven by credit risk and non-performing loans (NPLs), and the liquidity channel, driven by pro-cyclical government deposit withdrawals and sovereign debt issuance. The structural variance decomposition attributes over 54% of non-oil GDP variance and 53% of credit variance to oil price shocks, while bank capital shocks account for less than 0.1%, confirming the quantitative dominance of the liquidity channel. We identify a precautionary liquidity motive—a “liquidity buffer trap”—where banks maintain excess liquidity during booms to hedge against hydrocarbon volatility, structurally suppressing credit to the productive sector. Our counterfactual regime analysis reveals the stabilizing power of credit depth: banking conservatism protects long-term physical capital formation, and the ongoing financialization of the corporate sector— including the rapid growth of Islamic banking and sukuk markets—under Vision 2040 further amplifies this structural resilience. We acknowledge identification challenges inherent in small-sample structural estimation and discuss the sensitivity of results to key modeling assumptions.
abstract_zh: 本文以阿曼为案例，研究石油价格冲击对石油依赖型经济体银行部门的传导机制。我们构建了一个包含内生信贷配给与主权财富基金稳定规则的银行模块的DSGE模型，该模型根据阿曼制度目标进行校准，并采用贝叶斯方法进行约束。我们的结构方法区分了两种主要传导渠道：由信用风险与不良贷款驱动的偿付能力渠道，以及由顺周期的政府存款提取与主权债券发行驱动的流动性渠道。结构方差分解显示，石油价格冲击解释了非石油GDP方差的54%以上及信贷方差的53%，而银行资本冲击的贡献率不足0.1%，证实了流动性渠道在数量上的主导地位。我们识别出一种预防性流动性动机——即"流动性缓冲陷阱"——银行在经济繁荣期持有超额流动性以对冲碳氢化合物波动，从而结构性抑制了对生产性部门的信贷供给。反事实制度分析揭示了信贷深度的稳定效应：银行保守主义保护了长期实物资本形成，而"2040愿景"下企业部门持续金融化——包括伊斯兰银行与苏库克市场的快速增长——进一步放大了这种结构性韧性。我们承认小样本结构估计中固有的识别挑战，并讨论了关键建模假设对结果的敏感性。
authors: Yurii Sholomytskyi & Nathaniel Butler Blondel & Mr. Mumtaz Hussain
title: Should Oil Economies Worry About Oil Shocks’ Impact on the Banking System? The Case of Oman
title_zh: 石油经济体应担忧石油冲击对银行体系的影响吗？以阿曼为例

abstract: Investors reward reform progress. Econometric results suggest that holistic reforms, fiscal spending discipline, and monetary policy credibility are associated with a tightening of Qatar’s external sovereign credit spreads. In particular, investors may view fiscal spending discipline as an integral part of Qatar’s holistic reform and economic diversification. Greater broad-based reform progress also boosts the resilience of sovereign credit spreads to external shocks. The findings support fiscal and monetary policy reforms as part of the broader reform agenda in a holistic manner, as planned under the Third National Development Strategy.
abstract_zh: 投资者对改革进展给予回报。计量经济学结果表明，整体性改革、财政支出纪律和货币政策可信度与卡塔尔外部主权信用利差的收紧相关。特别是，投资者可能将财政支出纪律视为卡塔尔整体改革和经济多元化不可或缺的一部分。更广泛的全面改革进展也增强了主权信用利差抵御外部冲击的韧性。这些发现支持将财政和货币政策改革作为更广泛改革议程的一部分，以整体方式推进，正如第三国家发展战略所规划的那样。
title: Pricing Reform Progress: Evidence from Sovereign Spreads and Consensus Forecasts
title_zh: 定价改革进展：来自主权利差与共识预测的证据

abstract: Frontier Market (FM) status serves as a steppingstone for Low-Income Countries (LICs) aspiring to become Emerging Markets (EMs). Since the concept first emerged over three decades ago, FMs have gained substantial investment appeal, particularly after the 2008 Global Financial Crisis. At the same time, the recent series of global shocks starting with the COVID-19 pandemic highlighted the countries’ persistent vulnerabilities. This paper seeks to deepen our understanding of FMs by offering new analysis on the determinants of frontier market status and, using a dynamic country sample, examining the factors that help LICs attain and lose FM status. It finds that building robust macroeconomic fundamentals and ensuring good governance are critical for becoming an FM. In addition, the paper identifies flexible exchange rates, substantial official reserve buffers, and relatively low public debt and deficit levels as key contributors to lessening the sensitivity of FMs’ sovereign spreads to changes in global financial conditions.
abstract_zh: 前沿市场（FM）地位是低收入国家（LICs）迈向新兴市场（EMs）的跳板。自三十多年前这一概念首次提出以来，FM已获得显著的投资吸引力，尤其是在2008年全球金融危机之后。与此同时，从新冠疫情开始的一系列近期全球冲击凸显了这些国家持续存在的脆弱性。本文旨在通过提供关于前沿市场地位决定因素的新分析，并利用动态国家样本，考察帮助低收入国家获得和失去FM地位的因素，从而加深我们对FM的理解。研究发现，构建稳健的宏观经济基本面并确保良好的治理是成为FM的关键。此外，本文指出，灵活的汇率制度、充足的外汇储备缓冲、以及相对较低的公共债务和赤字水平，是降低FM主权利差对全球金融状况变化敏感性的关键因素。
authors: Younes Takki Chebihi & Naoya Kato & Maxwell Kushnir & Andreja Lenarcic & Yinhao Sun & Mr. Bilal Tabti
title: Frontier Markets: Analyzing Drivers of Market Growth and Sovereign Risks
title_zh: 前沿市场：市场增长与主权风险的驱动因素分析

abstract: This paper investigates the impact of natural disasters on the domestic sovereign yield curve, shedding light on their distinct transmission channels. Using a sample of 72 developing countries during the period 2000-20, and leveraging a newly compiled dataset on domestic treasury bill and bond yields, the findings from the fixed-effects and the local projection difference in difference estimations point to a disaster premium in the pricing of domestic government securities. While natural disasters significantly steepen the yield curve, their effects are confined to short-term maturity debts. In constrast, a worsening in climate vulnerability shifts upward the entire yield curve. Heightened fiscal stress and monetary policy stance emerge as the main transmission channels. These results underscore the importance of integrating resilience building into debt management and fiscal policy frameworks.
abstract_zh: 本文研究了自然灾害对国内主权收益率曲线的影响，揭示了其独特的传导渠道。基于2000-20年间72个发展中国家的样本，并利用新编制的国内国库券和债券收益率数据集，固定效应模型与局部投影双重差分估计的结果表明，国内政府证券定价中存在“灾害溢价”。自然灾害显著陡化了收益率曲线，但其影响仅限于短期债务。相比之下，气候脆弱性的恶化则使整条收益率曲线上移。财政压力加剧与货币政策立场成为主要传导渠道。这些结果凸显了将韧性建设纳入债务管理与财政政策框架的重要性。
authors: Mr. Kangni R Kpodar & Alassane Drabo & Carine Meyimdjui
title: Sovereign Risk and Natural Disaster Shocks: Unraveling the Domestic Yield Curve Response
title_zh: 主权风险与自然灾害冲击：国内收益率曲线反应的解析

abstract: The changing global economic landscape is likely to expose the Middle East, North Africa, and Pakistan (MENAP) and Caucasus and Central Asia (CCA) regions to more frequent external shocks, putting a premium on resilient and flexible macroeconomic policy frameworks. By using empirical analysis and model-based scenarios, this paper highlights the important roles of policy frameworks in stabilizing MENAP and CCA economies against adverse global shocks. Two messages stand out from the analysis. First, as countries make progress toward diversifying their exports and deepening domestic financial markets, credible inflation-targeting monetary policy regimes that allow greater exchange rate flexibility could enable faster adjustment to adverse global shocks. Second, adopting strong fiscal rules could help better anchor long-term expectations, reduce risk premiums, and help support countercyclical fiscal responses.
abstract_zh: 不断变化的全球经济格局可能使中东、北非和巴基斯坦（MENAP）以及高加索和中亚（CCA）地区面临更频繁的外部冲击，从而凸显了具有韧性和灵活性的宏观经济政策框架的重要性。通过实证分析和基于模型的场景模拟，本文强调了政策框架在稳定MENAP和CCA经济体以应对不利全球冲击中的关键作用。分析得出两个核心结论：第一，随着各国在出口多元化和深化国内金融市场方面取得进展，采用可信的通胀目标制货币政策框架并允许更大汇率灵活性，能够加速对不利全球冲击的调整；第二，实施强有力的财政规则有助于更好地锚定长期预期、降低风险溢价，并支持逆周期财政应对措施。
authors: Hasan Dudu & Mr. Troy D Matheson & Mr. Dirk V Muir & Karmen Naidoo & Salem M Nechi & Mr. Pedro C Rodriguez
china_relevance_reason: 研究对象为中东、北非、巴基斯坦及中亚地区，不涉及中国
title: Resilience by Design: What Role Can Policy Frameworks Play in the Middle East and Central Asia?
title_zh: 韧性设计：政策框架在中东和中亚地区的作用

abstract: This paper analyzes credit developments in the Caucasus and Central Asia (CCA) using several complementary approaches. First, it estimates long-run equilibrium credit levels based on economic fundamentals, providing benchmarks to assess whether observed credit levels are broadly aligned with country characteristics. Second, it applies statistical “gap” measures to identify periods of unusually rapid credit expansion that may signal emerging financial vulnerabilities. Third, it uses the Kalman filter to decompose credit into trend and cyclical elements conditional on macro variables. The results suggest there is scope for further financial deepening in all CCA economies, but the speed of household credit expansion warrants close monitoring. A comparative “horse race” of alternative indicators suggests that no single measure consistently outperforms others across countries, implying that combining various credit gap measures enhances the robustness of risk assessments.
abstract_zh: 本文采用多种互补方法分析高加索和中亚地区的信贷发展。首先，基于经济基本面估算长期均衡信贷水平，为评估实际信贷水平是否与各国特征基本一致提供基准。其次，运用统计"缺口"指标识别可能预示金融脆弱性出现的异常快速信贷扩张期。第三，利用卡尔曼滤波法将信贷分解为趋势成分与周期成分，并使其以宏观变量为条件。研究结果表明，所有高加索和中亚经济体均存在进一步深化金融的空间，但家庭信贷扩张速度需密切监测。通过比较不同指标的"赛马"分析发现，没有任何单一指标能在各国间持续优于其他指标，这意味着综合运用多种信贷缺口指标可增强风险评估的稳健性。
title: Credit Expansion in the Caucasus and Central Asia
title_zh: 高加索和中亚地区的信贷扩张

abstract: Using transaction-level data from the Korean tri-party repo market, we study how repo contract terms interact with collateral quality. Both haircuts and interest rates rise with collateral risk, consistent with existing evidence. Conditional on collateral quality, however, we find a trade-off: a one-percentage-point increase in the spread is associated with a 1.3-percentage-point reduction in the haircut. The same increase in the interest rate is associated with a smaller reduction in the haircut under heightened market uncertainty, indicating that insurance against default becomes more valuable as default risk rises. We show that the interaction between lenders’ incentives to acquire information and borrowers’ opportunistic default risk explains both the positive unconditional relationship and the negative conditional relationship between haircuts and interest rates.
abstract_zh: 利用韩国三方回购市场的交易数据，我们研究了回购合约条款如何与抵押品质量相互作用。保证金率和利率均随抵押品风险上升而上升，这与现有证据一致。然而，在控制抵押品质量后，我们发现一种权衡关系：利差每增加一个百分点，保证金率降低1.3个百分点。在市场不确定性加剧的情况下，利率的同等上升会导致保证金率降幅更小，这表明随着违约风险上升，针对违约的保险价值增加。我们证明，贷款人获取信息的动机与借款人机会主义违约风险之间的相互作用，解释了保证金率与利率之间正向的无条件关系以及负向的条件关系。
title: Haircut, interest rate, and collateral quality in the tri-party repo market: Evidence and theory
title_zh: 三方回购市场中的折扣率、利率与抵押品质量：证据与理论

abstract: We build a network formation game of firms with trade flows to study the adoption and usage of a new digital currency. In pairwise stable equilibria, we document endogenous heterogeneity and inefficiency in adoption, and explain how changing properties of the currency may increase usage but decrease adoption. We frame the model as a quadratic binary optimization problem and apply it to data. This approach resolves the long-standing complexity issue of network formation games and makes them empirically feasible, as demonstrated with a quantum computer.
abstract_zh: 我们构建了一个包含企业间贸易流量的网络形成博弈模型，以研究新型数字货币的采纳与使用情况。在成对稳定均衡中，我们记录了采纳行为的内生异质性与低效率现象，并解释了货币属性变化如何可能提升使用率却降低采纳度。我们将该模型表述为二次二元优化问题，并将其应用于实际数据。这一方法解决了网络形成博弈中长期存在的复杂性难题，使其在实证上可行，并通过量子计算机得到了验证。
journal: Journal of Economic Dynamics and Control
source_issue: Journal of Economic Dynamics and Control, Volume 190
title: Digital payments in network formation games: Theory of adoption and quantum algorithms
title_zh: 网络形成博弈中的数字支付：采纳理论与量子算法

abstract: We prove that a two-cycle equilibrium in a general equilibrium model with infinitely-lived agents (GEILA) constitutes an equilibrium in an overlapping generations (OLG) model. Conversely, an equilibrium in an OLG model that satisfies additional conditions is part of an equilibrium in a GEILA model. Our framework, which includes three assets (physical capital, a Lucas tree, and fiat money), encompasses both exchange and production economies. As an application, we demonstrate that equilibrium indeterminacy and rational asset price bubbles can arise not only in OLG models but also in GEILA models.
abstract_zh: 我们证明，在具有无限期存活主体的—般均衡模型（GEILA）中，一个两周期均衡构成了世代交叠（OLG）模型中的一个均衡。反之，满足附加条件的OLG模型中的均衡，也是GEILA模型均衡的一部分。我们的框架包含三种资产（实物资本、卢卡斯树和无息货币），涵盖了交换经济与生产经济。作为应用，我们证明均衡不确定性与理性资产价格泡沫不仅可能出现在OLG模型中，也可能出现在GEILA模型中。
title: The relationship between general equilibrium models with infinitely-lived agents and overlapping generations models, and some applications
title_zh: 无限期生存主体的一般均衡模型与世代交叠模型的关系及其若干应用

abstract: I study the impact of consumer reviews on the incentives for firms to participate in the market. I develop a model of endogenous entry in which firms produce goods of heterogeneous, unknown quality. Consumers engage in directed search, and prices are exogenously fixed. A rater uses consumer reviews to construct firm‐specific ratings that are informative of quality and help consumers direct their search. The main insight of the paper is that suppressing the reviews of highly‐rated firms strengthens entry incentives and improves consumer welfare.
abstract_zh: 本文研究了消费者评价对企业参与市场激励的影响。我构建了一个内生进入模型，其中企业生产异质性且质量未知的商品。消费者进行定向搜索，价格外生给定。评级机构利用消费者评价构建企业特定评级，该评级能反映质量信息并帮助消费者引导搜索。本文的核心发现是：抑制高评级企业的评价会增强企业进入市场的激励，并提升消费者福利。
title: Ratings design and barriers to entry
title_zh: 评级设计与进入壁垒

abstract: In the context of Krugman's (1979) canonical new trade model, we demonstrate that a country is better off in autarky than in free and costless trade when the productivity of its trading partner is sufficiently low.
abstract_zh: 在克鲁格曼（1979）经典新贸易模型的框架下，我们证明：当贸易伙伴的生产率足够低时，一国在自给自足状态下的福利水平优于自由且无成本的贸易状态。
title: When autarky trumps free and costless trade
title_zh: 当自给自足胜过自由且零成本的贸易

abstract: Nonpartisan voters can become polarized not because of ideology but because it is optimal for them to remain uninformed and cancel out the votes of uninformed voters on “the other side.” Indeed, when stuck in such a state of polarization, it is socially optimal to do so. Dynamics can lead an otherwise well‐functioning assembly into irreversible polarization. Reputation effects might only make things worse.
abstract_zh: 无党派选民之所以可能走向极化，并非源于意识形态，而是因为保持信息闭塞、抵消"另一方"信息闭塞选民的选票对其而言是最优选择。事实上，当陷入这种极化状态时，从社会整体来看这样做也是最优的。动态演化可能导致原本运作良好的议会陷入不可逆转的极化。声誉效应可能只会使情况进一步恶化。
title: Ruth, Anthony, and Clarence
title_zh: 《露丝、安东尼与克拉伦斯》

abstract: This paper compares digital and physical currency, focusing on a single intrinsic difference: digital, unlike physical currency, allows the monetary authority to trace the monetary flows in and out of the accounts. We show that this technological advance in recordkeeping can be used by the monetary authority to improve upon physical currency and achieve efficiency in a wide range of circumstances.
abstract_zh: 本文比较了数字货币与实物货币，聚焦于一个本质差异：与实物货币不同，数字货币使货币当局能够追踪账户中的资金流入与流出。我们证明，货币当局可利用这一记账技术的进步，在广泛情境下改进实物货币并实现效率提升。
title: Physical versus digital currency A difference that makes a difference
title_zh: 实物货币与数字货币：一种产生差异的差异

abstract: We study the welfare effects of ambiguous product information for a buyer with α ‐max‐min preferences and a price‐setting seller. The buyer privately receives information about her valuation. We show that both the seller and the buyer can benefit when this information is ambiguous, and we characterize all possible combinations of producer and consumer surplus, as evaluated under ambiguity‐sensitive preferences. Ambiguity concerning the valuation perceived by the buyer when making the purchase decision can induce the seller to change the price. Before receiving information, ambiguity concerning the purchase decision can make the buyer optimistic about buying only for high valuations, which relaxes the participation constraint.
abstract_zh: 我们研究了模糊产品信息对具有α-最大最小偏好的买方与定价卖方产生的福利效应。买方私下获取关于自身估值的信息。研究表明，当该信息存在模糊性时，买卖双方均可能获益，并刻画了在模糊敏感偏好评估下生产者剩余与消费者剩余的所有可能组合。买方在做出购买决策时所感知的估值模糊性，会促使卖方调整价格。在获取信息前，购买决策的模糊性可能使买方对仅在高估值时购买持乐观态度，从而放宽了参与约束条件。
title: Benefits and challenges of ambiguous product information
title_zh: 模糊产品信息的益处与挑战

abstract: We present a model in which news media shape beliefs by providing information (signals about an exogenous state) and narratives (models of what determines outcomes). To amplify consumers' engagement, the media maximize their anticipatory utility. We characterize the optimal monopolistic media strategy, highlighting the synergy between false narratives and biased information. Consumer heterogeneity gives rise to a novel menu‐design problem due to an “equilibrium data externality” among consumers. The optimal menu includes false narratives, and can generate polarized beliefs and choices without any information transmission. False narratives and polarization also feature in a competitive version of our model, albeit coupled with complete information. Nevertheless, competition can make some consumers objectively worse off.
abstract_zh: 我们构建了一个模型，其中新闻媒体通过提供信息（关于外生状态的信号）和叙事（解释结果决定因素的模型）来塑造信念。为提升消费者参与度，媒体最大化其预期效用。我们刻画了最优垄断媒体策略，揭示了虚假叙事与有偏信息之间的协同效应。消费者异质性引致了一个新颖的菜单设计问题，其根源在于消费者间存在的"均衡数据外部性"。最优菜单包含虚假叙事，且能在无任何信息传递的情况下催生极化信念与选择。在竞争性版本模型中，尽管伴随完全信息条件，虚假叙事与极化现象依然存在。然而，竞争可能使部分消费者的客观福利恶化。
title: News media as suppliers of narratives (and information)
title_zh: 新闻媒体作为叙事（及信息）的提供者

abstract: We compare the degree of coalitional manipulability across stable school‐choice mechanisms. Although no stable mechanism is group strategy‐proof for all school choice contexts, we show that the student‐optimal stable mechanism is the least manipulable by coalitions, whereas the school‐optimal stable mechanism is the most coalitionally manipulable. These results still hold when students can only report truncated preferences, when the set of coalitions is limited, or when schools cannot be declared unacceptable as long as there are more available seats than students. In contrast, if there is a shortage of seats and students have no outside options, the school‐optimal stable mechanism can be less manipulable by coalitions than the student‐optimal stable mechanism.
abstract_zh: 我们比较了不同稳定学校选择机制中联盟可操纵性的程度。尽管在所有的学校选择情境中，没有一种稳定机制是群体策略证明的，但我们发现，学生最优稳定机制是联盟可操纵性最低的，而学校最优稳定机制则是联盟可操纵性最高的。这些结果在学生只能报告截断偏好、联盟集合受到限制，或者当可用名额多于学生数量时学校不能被宣布为不可接受的情况下仍然成立。相反，如果名额短缺且学生没有外部选择，学校最优稳定机制的联盟可操纵性可能低于学生最优稳定机制。
title: Coalitional manipulability in school choice
title_zh: 学校选择中的联盟可操纵性

abstract: We study markets where heterogeneous agents first make investment decisions and then engage in a costly search to form productive matches. The trading process is a random search and bargaining with explicit search costs. Despite potential hold‐up and matching problems, we prove that the constrained efficient allocation is an equilibrium: the agents' private incentives to invest and to accept/reject potential partners as they search are perfectly aligned with the social benefit. Furthermore, we establish a new sorting result for two‐sided markets, equilibrium existence, and conditions for uniqueness.
abstract_zh: 我们研究了一个市场，其中异质性主体首先做出投资决策，随后进行有成本的搜索以形成生产性匹配。交易过程是一个带有明确搜索成本的随机搜索与讨价还价过程。尽管存在潜在的敲竹杠和匹配问题，我们证明了约束有效配置是一个均衡：主体在投资以及搜索过程中接受或拒绝潜在合作伙伴的私人激励与社会福利完全一致。此外，我们为双边市场建立了一个新的分类结果，证明了均衡的存在性，并给出了唯一性的条件。
title: Efficient investment, search, and sorting in matching markets
title_zh: 匹配市场中的有效投资、搜寻与分类

abstract: A decision‐maker faces uncertainty governed by a data‐generating process (DGP), which is only known to belong to a set of sequences of independent but possibly non‐identical distributions. A robust decision maximizes the expected payoff against the worst possible DGP in this set. This paper characterizes when and how such robust decisions can be objectively improved with data; that is, can yield higher expected payoffs under the true DGP regardless of which DGP is the truth. It further develops simple and novel inference procedures that achieve such improvement, while common methods (e.g., maximum likelihood) may fail to do so.
abstract_zh: 决策者面临由数据生成过程（DGP）主导的不确定性，该过程仅已知属于一组独立但可能非同分布序列的集合。稳健决策旨在最大化该集合中最差可能DGP下的期望收益。本文刻画了此类稳健决策何时以及如何能够通过数据实现客观改进——即无论真实DGP为何，均能在真实DGP下获得更高期望收益。进一步地，本文提出了实现此类改进的简洁新颖推断方法，而常见方法（如极大似然估计）可能无法达成这一目标。
title: Improving robust decisions with data
title_zh: 利用数据改进稳健决策

abstract: This paper develops a general theory to recover the inverse welfare function that rationalizes a given tax schedule as optimal. Our theory allows for complex environments including the presence of multidimensional tax schedules, bunching/jumping behavior, optimization frictions, general equilibrium effects, and externalities. We show that inverse welfare functions can be used to test for Pareto efficiency, construct Pareto improving reforms, and characterize the set of welfare improving local reforms, thereby extending previous results to more general environments. We show numerically that allowing for such generalities can have meaningful impacts on inverse welfare functions.
abstract_zh: 本文构建了一个一般性理论，用于恢复将给定税收计划视为最优的逆福利函数。该理论适用于复杂环境，包括多维税收计划、聚集/跳跃行为、优化摩擦、一般均衡效应及外部性。研究表明，逆福利函数可用于检验帕累托效率、构建帕累托改进型改革，并刻画福利改进型局部改革的集合，从而将既有结论拓展至更一般化的环境。数值分析表明，考虑此类一般性因素会对逆福利函数产生显著影响。
title: A general theory of inverse welfare functions
title_zh: 逆福利函数的一般理论

abstract: We investigate the management of information provision to maximize user engagement. A principal sequentially reveals signals to an agent who has a limited amount of information processing capacity and can choose to exit at any time. We identify a “dilution” strategy—sending rare but highly informative signals—that maximizes user engagement. The platform's engagement metric shapes the direction and magnitude of biases in provided information relative to a user‐optimal benchmark. Even without intertemporal commitment, the platform replicates full‐commitment revenue by inducing the user's belief to remain “as uncertain as” the prior until the rare, decisive signal arrives and induces stopping. We apply our results to two contexts: an ad‐supported internet media platform and a teacher attempting to engage test‐motivated students.
abstract_zh: 我们研究了如何管理信息提供以最大化用户参与度。一位委托人向具有有限信息处理能力且可随时选择退出的代理人顺序揭示信号。我们识别出一种“稀释”策略——发送罕见但信息量大的信号——以最大化用户参与度。平台的参与度指标决定了所提供信息相对于用户最优基准的偏差方向与幅度。即使缺乏跨期承诺能力，平台也能通过使用户信念保持“与先验一样不确定”，直到罕见的关键信号出现并引发停止行为，从而复制完全承诺下的收益。我们将研究结果应用于两个场景：广告支持的互联网媒体平台，以及试图吸引考试驱动型学生的教师。
title: Engagement maximization
title_zh: 参与度最大化
